labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The text states that dump/restore, pg_upgrade, or logical replication is required to migrate from earlier releases and warns of compatibility-affecting changes.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: User-defined aggregates and operators referencing the listed array functions must be dropped before upgrading and recreated afterward.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The deprecated containment operators @ and ~ are removed, so applications using them will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: to_tsquery() and websearch_to_tsquery() now produce different tsquery output for queries containing discarded tokens, which can change application results.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: websearch_to_tsquery() output for quoted text with adjacent discarded tokens changes from 'aaa' <2> 'bbb' to 'aaa' <-> 'bbb', a behavior change.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: EXTRACT() now returns numeric instead of float8, and EXTRACT(date) now errors for units outside the date type, which can break applications.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: var_samp() and stddev_samp() with numeric input now return NULL instead of NaN for a single NaN input, a changed result.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: has_column_privilege() now returns false instead of raising an error for non-existent or dropped attribute numbers, changing behavior that callers may rely on.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Window frames with infinite offsets now return different results, so queries that previously gave incorrect output will change, which is conservatively treated as a behavior change.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The factorial operators ! and !! and the function numeric_fac() are removed, which breaks any code using them.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: factorial() of a negative number is now disallowed, where it previously returned 1, so such queries will now error.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for postfix (right-unary) operators is removed, and dumps containing them need attention, as pg_dump and pg_upgrade warn about them.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: \D and \W now match newlines in newline-sensitive mode, changing regex results, and users must rewrite patterns to keep the old behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Constraints are now disregarded when matching back-references, which changes the matching results of existing regular expressions.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Using \w as a range start or end in character classes is now disallowed, so existing patterns using it will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Custom server parameter names must now use only characters valid in unquoted SQL identifiers, which may break existing configurations.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The password_encryption default changes to scram-sha-256, which can break clients that only support md5, and legacy Boolean-like values are no longer accepted.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The server parameter vacuum_cleanup_index_scale_factor is removed, so configurations setting it will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The server parameter operator_precedence_warning is removed, so configurations setting it will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The clientcert values 1, 0, and no-verify are no longer supported and verify-ca is disallowed with cert authentication, so pg_hba.conf entries must be updated.
